Kai: @channel Tiny miracle update — weekly peak just topped 42M requests and our queues stayed chill. we are allowed to be smug for 5 minutes, right? :sunglasses: :tada:
Harper: SMUG TIME. also can someone remind me which mythical person fixed the rate limiter? want to send them cookies. :cookie:
Lin: that was @Jules! late-night heroics and one very brave log message.
Jules: i accept cookies and a ridiculous hat.
Mateo: celebration options: 1) mix-tape playlist + earbuds for remote folks, 2) sparkling socks (limited run), 3) tiny LED trophy "The Keepers of the Queue". vote with reactions.
Nia: mixtape please. i will curate "latency lullabies" and also make a 3-minute hype track for the reveal.
Kai: socks are adorable though. sample op to order socks + pins if budget approved:
```
/order-swag --item "sparkle-socks" --qty 80 --item "mini-pin" --qty 80 --deliver-by 2026-09-10
```
Harper: Ops check @OpsBot — any budgeting pain for a 80-person sock run + 10 trophies?
OpsBot: Automated: FinanceOps notified for budget approval. Estimated range for 80 socks + 10 mini trophies: $900-$1,800 depending on shipping and customization. No conflicting maintenance windows this Friday 17:00-20:00 PT.
Lin: logistics idea: do a 10-min reveal at 5pm PT during standup, play the mixtape, drop the confetti GIF, and then optional sock distribution for folks in-office. remote folks get a link to a playlist + e-gift card.
Jules: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebration-music-3oEduSbSGpGaRX2Vri (very mood)
Mateo: kudos time: one-line shoutouts for the all-hands slide please — who saved us this sprint?
Nia: huge kudos to @Lin for the cache tuning. peak p99 dropped like magic.
Harper: shoutout to @Mateo for the graceful degradation flow. customers never saw the wobble.
Kai: extra love to infra on-call. zero alerts for three consecutive rollouts. that's rare.
Jules: i second the cookie offer. and also, who wants to help design the trophy? i can 3D-print a tiny server with blinking LED.
Mateo: i'll handle engraving text suggestions. my vote: "We Served It Hot" or "Kept the Bits Flowing" (vote in thread).
Nia: vote cast for "Kept the Bits Flowing". it's peak startup poetry.
Lin: timeline: finalize swag by Wednesday, playlist live at 5pm Friday, socks ship next week. DM me addresses if you want physical swag.
Harper: remote-first note: make swag opt-in. love from home-office folks.
Kai: final tiny ask — if you got a one-line kudos for someone, drop it now. i'll compile for the single-slide shoutout. :heart:
Jules: kudos to @Kai for keeping spirits high and for the terrible puns.
Mateo: kudos to @Jules for the late-night fix. cookies incoming.
OpsBot: Automated: no critical incidents during this traffic period. Event safety: OK. FinanceOps asked to respond in 48h for allocation.
Kai: perfect, i'll nudge FinanceOps and drop the calendar invite once approved. party responsibly, hydrate, and bring your worst dance moves for the mixtape. :headphones:
